name: shiksha-circuit-tutorial
title: Experiment in the Circuit Lab

chapters.caption: 1. Request a hypothetical 6 V circuit; no physical wiring.
2. Open Circuit Lab. These readings are mocked locally.
3. Inspect the 6 V supply and the 1,000 ohm resistor.
5. Double R1 to 2,000 ohms, then run the local mock again.
6. Mock result: 6 V / 2,000 ohms = 3 mA, half the current.

description: Inspect a hypothetical 6 V resistor circuit, double its resistance, and compare explicitly mocked Ohm's-law readings: 6 mA becomes 3 mA.
capture: Actual unchanged React frontend; scripted interactions, synthetic course data and in-memory API responses.
timing: Captured frames are paced for readability, not a performance benchmark.
isolation: Fresh browser context. External services blocked; all API calls simulated. No remote course creation.
